title: Volume device info named-pipe fast path
contracts: File_NtQueryVolumeInformationFile owns the named-pipe FileFsDeviceInformation fast path
NtQueryVolumeInformationFile output shape is selected by FsInformationClass
FILE_FS_DEVICE_INFORMATION.DeviceType identifies the associated device object type
DeviceType equal to FILE_DEVICE_NAMED_PIPE is enough to answer this volume-info query
FileFsDeviceInformation must not route through object-name resolution before returning the named-pipe device result
Recursive File_NtQueryVolumeInformationFile calls while the hook is already translating a handle path must use the native volume-info owner directly
KnownDll sandbox probing must not let volume-info queries recurse through SbieDll_GetHandlePath
KPATH-003 and SREV-171 own broader object-name routing for named-pipe handles
this SREV owns the volume-info fast path and reentrancy gate
local_edges: FileFsDeviceInformation + Length gate -> native volume info query
DeviceType == FILE_DEVICE_NAMED_PIPE -> copy device info to caller
named pipe fast path -> return before Sandboxie handle-path lookup
ipc_KnownDlls_lock or file_NtQueryVolumeInformation_lock -> native volume info query
non-named-pipe volume info -> normal Sandboxie volume/path translation
runtime_gate: Windows named-pipe FileFsDeviceInformation matrix with pending pipe I/O, normal disk volume-info controls, and Start.exe KnownDll/volume-info reentrancy smoke
